title: Is Yellowstone overdue for an eruption? The USGS says no #Shorts
description:
Is Yellowstone "overdue" for a super-eruption? The USGS says plainly: no. The famous 700,000-year average is built on just two gaps between three eruptions.

▶ Full documentary (Part 1, What's Really Under Yellowstone): https://youtu.be/-vkXqMrSljM
